subject: humanities
passage: In Dhaka, Bangladesh, many cycle rickshaws are decorated with hand-painted pictures of film stars, animals, and village ______ the bright designs help each rickshaw stand out on the city's crowded streets. In 2023, UNESCO recognized Dhaka's rickshaws and rickshaw painting as an important part of the world's cultural heritage.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Many cycle rickshaws are decorated with … village scenes" and "the bright designs help each rickshaw stand out" are both independent clauses. A semicolon can join two closely related independent clauses.
explanation.A: Correct. A semicolon correctly joins the two closely related independent clauses.
explanation.B: Incorrect. When "and" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.C: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together (a run-on sentence).
explanation.D: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
